01 / A small ritual, shared

Not everything needs
to move faster.

✳

There’s something good about moving a piece with your own hands. Thinking for a moment. Coming back for another turn.

Slowboard brings that feeling to connected play. Two physical boards, one shared game — and a reason to make a little time for each other.

together.

Make it physical.

Lift a magnetic piece. Place it on the board. Sensors beneath the surface detect the change.

The connected board sends the proposed move over Wi-Fi to a shared cloud game session.

A light on the other board communicates the update. The pieces still move by human hands.

04 / Thoughtfully simple

A little technology.
A lot of possibility.

The current prototype is built around a 6 × 6 playing surface and a custom PCB. The technology sits quietly underneath, leaving the play on top.

36 positions
One shared surface to explore different games.
Magnetic sensing
Reed switches detect the presence of a piece.
Light as a language
RGB LEDs communicate game feedback, square by square.
Connected at heart
An ESP32 links the board to a cloud game session over Wi-Fi.
WORK IN PROGRESS

Exploring checkers and Battleship variants for the 6 × 6 format. Hardware, game rules, and connected play are still in development.

Good things take a little time.
